spec_01.name: Garrison Commander
spec_01.description: All your Watchtowers, Outposts, and Crystal Towers gain +15 attack and +1 attack range.

spec_02.name: Bloodrider
spec_02.description: When one of your Riders kills an enemy, it may attack once more this turn at half attack and without retaliation.

spec_03.name: Siege Tactician
spec_03.description: Your Siege units deal 25% of their damage to all enemy units surrounding their target.

spec_04.name: Drill Sergeant
spec_04.description: Your Spearman and Swordsman units can move and attack immediately after being recruited.

spec_05.name: Deathmender
spec_05.description: When one of your Spearmen, Scouts, or Guards dies, a Gravestone is left on their tile. Pay 1 crystal to raise a flying Gargoyle from any Gravestone.

spec_06.name: Archmage
spec_06.description: Your Mages can cast 2 spells per turn instead of 1.

spec_07.name: Ashwright
spec_07.description: Your Charcoal Kilns affect mines and deep mines within 3 tiles instead of 2.

spec_08.name: Trapsmith
spec_08.description: Your Scouts can place a Scout Trap within 1 tile(s) of their position (costs 4 wood). The next non-FLYING enemy to enter it takes 60 damage and is stunned for 1 turn(s).

spec_09.name: Watch Captain
spec_09.description: Your garrisoned Watchtowers, Outposts, and Crystal Towers fire a preventive shot at 50% damage when an enemy enters their range.

spec_10.name: Cinder Warden
spec_10.description: Your Scouts can extinguish BURNING and CORRUPTED tiles within 1 tile(s), consuming their action.

spec_11.name: Farsight Marshal
spec_11.description: Your Scouts gain +1 attack range and become ranged.

spec_12.name: Tramplelord
spec_12.description: Your Riders push enemies one tile away on every hit (KNOCKBACK).

spec_13.name: Hellbinder
spec_13.description: All your SUMMONED units gain the RAGE and CLEAVE tags.

spec_14.name: Hearthsteward
spec_14.description: Each of your Farms can house 1 extra farmer.

spec_15.name: Forgemaster
spec_15.description: Units recruited within 5 rows of the lava front gain the CINDERBORN tag (+15 ATK and immunity to BURNING tile damage).

spec_16.name: The Martyr
spec_16.description: When one of your units is consumed by lava, all surviving Crystal Chambers begin resonating as if a chamber were destroyed.

spec_17.name: Bombardier
spec_17.description: Your Siege units gain the BATTERY tag: each adjacent friendly unit grants +7 ATK, up to 3 stacks.

spec_18.name: Echo Warden
spec_18.description: While resonating, each Crystal Chamber within 3 rows of the lava front generates +1 extra crystal per turn.

spec_19.name: Wallbreaker
spec_19.description: Your Archers deal 50% bonus damage when attacking buildings.

spec_20.name: Deathsworn
spec_20.description: Your Archers gain the BERSERK tag: when HP drops below 50%, they gain +50% ATK. Once triggered, it stays active even if HP recovers.

spec_21.name: Pathfinder
spec_21.description: Capturing an enemy Stronghold immediately reveals the full zone it belongs to.

spec_22.name: The Sundered
spec_22.description: Your Mages unlock the Rupture spell: deals 50% of the target's current HP as damage for 1 crystal.

spec_23.name: The Matriarch
spec_23.description: Doubles farmer and noble housing caps and recruitment unit limits. New units have their iron and wood recruitment cost and max HP halved, rounded up.

spec_24.name: Field Chirurgeon
spec_24.description: Player units that took no action this turn are healed for 30 HP at the end of the player turn.

spec_25.name: Estate Warden
spec_25.description: Each Patrician House houses 1 extra noble.

spec_26.name: Quartermaster
spec_26.description: 🎖️ Each recruitment building supports 1 additional unit. Crystal Caves and Crystal Chambers are not affected.
